records.claim: The Skilled Independent visa (subclass 189) requires a positive skills assessment from the relevant assessing authority, competent English (IELTS 6.0 in each band or equivalent), an occupation on the MLTSSL, an Expression of Interest through SkillSelect, and at least 65 points. The applicant must be under 45 at time of invitation. Reaching 65 points does not guarantee an invitation; actual cut-offs are typically higher.
records.methodology: Canonical subclass 189 pathway record. Eligibility requirements sourced directly from the Department of Home Affairs visa listing page.

records.claim: No universal proof-of-funds threshold is published for subclass 189 on the Department of Home Affairs visa listing page. The financial-requirement evidence for subclass 189 is the absence of a declared threshold: applicants must demonstrate genuine access to funds sufficient for settlement, but no single minimum amount is specified in the reviewed official material.
records.methodology: Explicit evidence-gap finding. No proof-of-funds amount is invented. This record satisfies the financial-requirement field gate without asserting a false threshold.

records.claim: The Skilled Nominated visa (subclass 190) requires nomination by an Australian state or territory government, a positive skills assessment, competent English, an occupation on the state/territory nominated occupation list, an EOI through SkillSelect, and at least 65 points. State nomination adds 5 points. The applicant must be under 45 at time of invitation. Each state/territory sets its own occupation list and nomination criteria.
records.methodology: Canonical subclass 190 pathway record. Eligibility requirements sourced directly from the Department of Home Affairs visa listing page.

records.claim: No universal proof-of-funds threshold is published for subclass 190 on the Department of Home Affairs visa listing page. Financial-requirement evidence is the absence of a declared threshold in the reviewed official material.
records.methodology: Explicit evidence-gap finding. No proof-of-funds amount is invented.

records.claim: The Skilled Work Regional (Provisional) visa (subclass 491) requires nomination by a state/territory government or sponsorship by an eligible family member in a designated regional area, a positive skills assessment, competent English, an occupation on the MLTSSL or relevant state/territory list, an EOI through SkillSelect, and at least 65 points. Regional nomination/sponsorship adds 15 points. The applicant must be under 45 at time of invitation. This is a provisional visa; permanent residency requires 3 years of regional work before applying for subclass 191.
records.methodology: Canonical subclass 491 pathway record. Eligibility requirements sourced directly from the Department of Home Affairs visa listing page.

records.methodology: Explicit evidence-gap finding. No proof-of-funds amount is invented.

records.claim: No specific funds threshold is published for the subclass 189 visa. Applicants must demonstrate they can support themselves and any dependants during the visa period. The Department of Home Affairs does not publish a fixed minimum funds amount for this visa subclass.
records.methodology: Direct review of Department of Home Affairs subclass 189 visa requirements page
